dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides several expert‑level thresholds and decision points not commonly memorised (e.g., >20% noncurrent bytes = high‑confidence opportunity, >50% = severe; explicit minimum‑duration charge modeling, small‑object surcharge, monitoring‑fee break‑even size, exact JSON rule snippets). However much of the pricing table and basic lifecycle concepts are restatements of public docs, so full 20 is not earned.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Lists AWS‑specific pre‑flight CLI steps, pagination advice, and backup before put‑lifecycle, but some procedures are generic (e.g., cross‑region cost variance is only mentioned, not detailed) and rollback steps beyond JSON backup are not fully fleshed out.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Comprehensive NEVER list with concrete reasons (small‑object IA surcharge, minimum‑duration charges, expiration vs noncurrent rules, Glacier retrieval cost, Intelligent‑Tiering monitoring fee, directory‑bucket limitations, etc.). Lacks a few niche pitfalls (e.g., CRR storage‑class mismatch) so deduct one point.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter, description, keywords, activation triggers, and invocation schema are all present and well‑formed. The "when to invoke" section is slightly redundant with activation triggers, and the description could be tighter, thus a small deduction.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document is layered (quick reference, mindset, process steps, anti‑patterns, safety checks), yet some dense sections (full pricing matrix, extensive rule JSON) appear early, risking cognitive overload before the core decision flow is understood.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (put‑bucket‑lifecycle‑configuration) are tightly guarded by mandatory confirmation, backup, and validation steps. Creative analysis sections are appropriately open. Only a minor gap: no explicit rate‑limit guidance for large‑scale batch updates.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (What it does → Quick reference → Mindset → Pre‑flight → Process → Output → Anti‑patterns → Safety). The pattern is coherent, earning near‑max.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Model output examples reveal inconsistencies: compliance‑archive bucket marked OPPORTUNITY_FOUND despite zero savings and contradictory cost calculations; data‑lake‑curated recommendation shows no savings yet flags an opportunity; missing noncurrent‑version transition rules in some outputs. These gaps indicate the skill’s guidance cannot be executed reliably without error.
